name: Coastal Plastic Molding Inc

about:
Coastal Plastic Molding Inc. was founded in 1984 in Alvin, Texas, just south of Houston. The company began as a small family-owned operation and has remained under family ownership throughout its growth.

The firm provides full-service plastic manufacturing, including injection molding of thermoplastic parts, extrusion, in-house tooling and mold making, design engineering support, prototyping, short-run and high-volume production, and secondary operations such as trimming, drilling, assembly, and packaging. Its 20,000-square-foot facility runs molding operations 24 hours a day, equipped with electric and hydraulic presses, including a 180-ton JSW all-electric machine and MATSIU material dryers.

Coastal serves a broad range of industries across the United States, including pharmaceutical and medical, aerospace, construction, industrial, electronics, consumer products, geophysical, and filtration. Customers range from prototype developers to large-scale OEMs.

The company emphasizes its Texas-based, family-owned identity as a differentiator, highlighting in-house tooling to avoid overseas dependencies, electric molding technology that reduces waste and energy consumption, an independent quality control department, and a commitment to transparent communication and local job retention.
